sources_considered.why: Documents systematic hallucination-mitigation research and its limitations.
Primary experimental evidence of systematic generalization in a restricted setting; relevant counterweight to an overly broad interpretation.
The doctoral-consortium abstract describes research questions but does not establish whether commonsense reasoning has a general solution.

evidence_items.explanation: The survey documents numerous systematic mitigation methods and discusses their limitations. Their existence challenges a reading of no principled approaches, but does not establish a complete solution to hallucinations.

evidence_items.explanation: The authors demonstrate systematic generalization through meta-learning on specified tasks. This is substantive prior progress, but neither its scope nor its date makes it decisive evidence of a general solution for contemporary LLMs.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved evidence does not comprehensively cover every problem included in the thread.
